products.title: Products
products.summary: Power and control cables, service and aerial bunched cables up to 1.1 kV, covered conductors up to 33 kV, overhead conductors for lines up to 800 kV and galvanised earth wire, made at PCI's works in Dankuni, West Bengal.

cables.title: Cables
cables.summary: PCI's power, control and service cables, including aerial bunched cable, LT XLPE cable and covered conductors up to 33 kV.

conductors.title: Overhead conductors
conductors.summary: Stranded aluminium, aluminium alloy and steel-reinforced conductor families, including AAC, AAAC, ACSR, AACSR, AL-59, ACAR and ECO, for lines up to 800 kV.

earth-wire.title: Earth wire
earth-wire.summary: Galvanised steel earth and stay wire for overhead power networks.

about-us.title: About us
about-us.summary: PCI Cables Industries manufactures PVC and XLPE insulated power and control cables, service and aerial bunched cables up to 1.1 kV, covered conductors up to 33 kV, overhead conductors and earth wire at its works in Dankuni, West Bengal.

management.title: Management
management.summary: Meet the leadership team guiding PCI Cables' manufacturing, sales and business development.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.summary: PCI Cables holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certification, and BIS licences covering its cables and conductors.

clients.title: Clients
clients.summary: PCI Cables supplies state electricity boards, central government organisations, public sector undertakings and metro railways.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.summary: Follow PCI Cables from its start in West Bengal on 6 September 2013 through cable and conductor manufacturing, first exports and new product milestones.

epc.title: EPC & turnkey contracting
epc.summary: PCI Cables undertakes EPC and turnkey projects for power transmission and distribution systems.

testing.title: Testing facilities
testing.summary: PCI's in-house laboratory is equipped with modern testing equipment, properly installed and periodically calibrated, to test its cables and conductors.
